appearance.title: Appearance & startup
appearance.desc: 「Follow system」 tracks your OS light/dark setting in real time; your choice is stored in this browser and survives refresh.

language.title: Interface language
language.desc: Applies immediately without reload; your choice is stored in this browser.

autostart.label: Launch at login
autostart.desc: Start the LanDeck console automatically when you log into this computer.

silent.label: Silent start
silent.desc: On boot, run in the tray without showing a window; opening from tray or shortcut still shows the window.
silent.onDesc: Next boot stays in the tray; opening the shortcut manually still shows the window.
silent.offDesc: Next boot shows the window normally.

lightweight.label: Lightweight mode
lightweight.desc: Releases the UI memory when the window is closed, keeping only the tray and background service; reopening rebuilds the UI (data is locally cached and shows instantly).
lightweight.onDesc: Closing the window releases UI memory, keeping only the tray and background service; reopening rebuilds the UI (data still shows instantly).
lightweight.offDesc: The UI stays in the background after closing; reopening is instant.
